scope: Schema61 per-view slot1 persistence and service lifecycle contract. Controller wiring and actual runtime reblock remain open.
binary_layout: After body/FP passive slot3 fields, write body held count and entries, then FP held count/entries iff FP exists. Each entry: string group, f32 animation time, bool easing, optional f32 offset/easeStart/lastInput, f32 easeEnd/weighted/output, optional retirement duration/optional start, bool inactive, optional captured pose. No contact ID.

per_view: Same resource alias in independent body/FP clocks; additional inactive resource retained.
admission: Alive Active actor with body clock; FP only on Player with independent FP clock.
ASCII-case-insensitive unique resource aliases; at most one resident held slot per view.
Same alias cannot also exist in legacy retiring vector.
Finite samples/timing, positive activation/retirement interval, valid pose tracks and strict booleans.
Pending cached activation, immediate inactive caches, unanchored fades and expiry before first input retain the native partial timing masks. Other partial timing is rejected.
Inactive retirement requires anchored interval already elapsed in that view.
migration: Versions1..60 add empty caches only. Never invent resident history from action6, or relabel a nonempty old-version held cache as valid. Older-version C++ service capture rejects before destination mutation.
pose_lifecycle: Captured source is retained during resident NI5 or a shared NI3 retirement span. Positive peer reset preserves requested destination frame and both frozen layers use the new fade. Immediate deactivation and expiry clear the pose; inactive caches never retain a live pose.
